subject: Workshop refund query
body:
Evening spreadsheet workshop — form review

A submission reaching the queue and a refund being approved are separate stages. The page currently returns without a clear received message, so people are submitting again. That produces duplicates rather than reassurance.

Suggested fix: show the request reference after submission, with a plain received label and the next contact step. Avoid wording that promises a decision at this point.

Admissions can match follow-up questions to the reference. Payment documents should be sent privately, not pasted into the workshop chat. I'll ask Maja to check the screen once we agree the wording. Priya
title: Workshop refund query
